parameters.subject: ={{ '[RAG alert] ' + ($json.workflow?.name ?? 'Workflow') + ' — ' + ($json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? 'Trigger failure') }}
parameters.message:
={{ [
  'Workflow: ' + ($json.workflow?.name ?? 'Unavailable'),
  'Failed step: ' + ($json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted ?? $json.trigger?.error?.node?.name ?? 'Trigger'),
  'Execution ID: ' + ($json.execution?.id ?? 'Unavailable'),
  '',
  'Error:',
  ($json.execution?.error?.message ?? $json.trigger?.error?.message ?? 'No error message provided'),
  '',
  'Execution link:',
  ($json.execution?.url ?? 'Unavailable — open n8n and check Executions'),
  '',
  'Next action: Open the execution and inspect the failed step. For indexing or evaluation errors, also check the operations-server terminal.'
].join('\n') }}
